boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Load cbr/live-performance-remedy-matrix.json for contract-level authority reservations and keep the mutation receipt for mutation counts only.

preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the orchestration failure, award no scan credit, and rerun only with a parse-safe method.
